definitions.explanation: A room containing a toilet. The most common word for toilet/restroom in modern Japanese.

examples.japanese: トイレ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧トイレ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦きます→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll go to the restroom for a moment.

examples.japanese: トイレ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧、トイレ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{一階|いっかい}→一階：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, is the restroom on the second floor or the first floor?

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧トイレ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}かせて→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: My child says they want to go to the restroom, so please let them go right away.

notes:
トイレ is the most common and neutral word for toilet/restroom in modern Japanese, from English "toilet."

ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
- お{手洗|てあら}い: polite term, literally "hand-washing place"
- {化粧室|けしょうしつ}: very polite, "powder room" (used in announcements)
- {便所|べんじょ}: older/crude term, avoid in polite speech
- {洗面所|せんめんじょ}: washroom (may include toilet area)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- トイレに{行|い}く: to go to the toilet
- トイレを{借|か}りる: to use (someone's) toilet
- トイレ{休憩|きゅうけい}: bathroom break

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese toilets ({和式|わしき}トイレ) traditionally require squatting. Modern Western-style toilets ({洋式|ようしき}トイレ) often have advanced features like {温水|おんすい}シャワー (bidet), {暖房|だんぼう}{便座|べんざ} (heated seat), and {音姫|おとひめ} (sound-masking device).
